# Pinned Android platform-tools

These archives are the exact platform-tools used by the launchers. Keeping them in the
repository makes first-run setup independent of Google's floating `latest` URL.

```text
ee39ad5967e95c2a07f04dbcbde96b1a0c916ba376096db5d2f498b7727a5d1d  platform-tools-darwin-37.0.1.zip
45f4d63113e895ebde0c90f194099a4676b6ac653bd28d54314a9e022bbc1a99  platform-tools-windows.zip
```

The Windows archive is platform-tools 37.0.1 (`source.properties` inside confirms).
Each archive contains Google's `NOTICE.txt`; see also `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
